name: Garrett 2019 inotuzumab ozogamicin PopPK scenarios
description: Exact Table 1/Table 2/supplement/source-status checks plus deterministic fixed-effect PK dynamic probes.

scenarios.name: Table 2 final model parameter checks
scenarios.description: Exact article Table 2 fixed-effect, uncertainty, random-effect, covariance, residual-error, and bootstrap scalar values.

scenarios.name: Study design and simulation text checks
scenarios.description: Exact study population, observation count, VPC count, fractionated dose design, and published C4D1 AUC/half-life/accumulation source targets.

scenarios.name: Source packet completeness checks
scenarios.description: Exact flags for the official paper, PDF, supplement, preprint, and figure-digitization status.

scenarios.name: ALL reference covariate equation checks at C4D1
scenarios.description: Deterministic fixed-effect equation check for ALL, no rituximab, BBSA 1.84 m2, BLSTPB 5.25%, evaluated at 1848 h (reported Day 78/C4D1).

scenarios.name: BBSA percentile covariate formula checks
scenarios.description: Fixed-effect formula checks for the text-reported 10th percentile BBSA 1.55 m2 and 90th percentile BBSA 2.21 m2 effects on CL1, CL2, and V1.

scenarios.name: ALL 1.8 mg/m2/cycle fractionated regimen dynamic smoke
scenarios.description: Deterministic fixed-effect smoke simulation for the published ALL regimen. This exercises the ODE and can be compared visually with Figure 7 behavior, but it is not a NONMEM population-percentile or VPC reproduction.
